note: sweep_best is what the dev-split sweep chose; shipped is what segmenter.py actually uses. Where they differ, see overrides.

overrides.LEAD_FRAC: The sweep objective is scored at a 2 s boundary tolerance only, where 0.19 and 0.21 are within 0.003 F1 of each other. At 1 s tolerance 0.21 is far better (F1 0.553 vs 0.486), and 0.21 is also closer to the physically measured lead (4.66 s / 20.9 s = 0.223).
overrides.REOPEN_MERGE_MS: Inert on dataset A -- every value from 0 to 8000 ms gives identical metrics, because A's row ids carry the case id so the same-key branch already merges re-selections. Kept at 2500 as a guard for dataset B, whose row selectors are positional: there a genuine re-click on the same row index would otherwise open a second case. Untested -- see the report's assumptions.

objective: boundary F1@2s + mean IoU + ARI, on the dev split
